# A 90-day plan for both stores

## 1. Situation summary

Net revenue of both stores over the last four weeks reached 1.23 billion VND [[kpi:ALL/net_revenue:w28]], up 4.6% [[kpi:ALL/net_revenue:p28_change]] on the four weeks before.

The average ticket is 52,314 VND [[kpi:ALL/avg_ticket:w28]] over 23,600 invoices [[kpi:ALL/invoices:w28]].

## 2. Strengths and weaknesses

- Strength: the topping attach rate is 31.25% [[kpi:ALL/attach_rate_topping:w28]], and the best-selling item brings 10.1% of revenue [[items:ALL/i01:share]].
- Weakness: the discount rate rose to 4.25% [[kpi:ALL/discount_rate:w28]]; cash takes 35.2% [[payments:ALL/cash:share]], down 3.2 percentage points [[payments:ALL/cash:share_change]].

## 3. Priority initiatives

### Initiative 1: Suggest a larger size for the best sellers

- **Evidence:** Bubble milk tea sold 3,120 cups [[items:ALL/i01:qty]] in four weeks, bringing 124.8 million VND [[items:ALL/i01:net]].
- **Action:** Cashiers suggest size L on every milk tea order.
- **Expected impact:** Estimated average ticket up 5% (52,314 × 1.05 ≈ 54,930 VND).
- **Effort:** Low.
- **KPI:** avg_ticket
- **How to read the KPI in the app:** Week report, average ticket card.
- **First step:** Brief the cashiers next Monday.

### Initiative 2: Bring the S1 combos to S2

- **Evidence:** In week 2026-W45 the average ticket of S1 is 55,120 VND [[kpi:S1/avg_ticket:w28]], above S2 at 48,761 VND [[kpi:S2/avg_ticket:w28]].
- **Action:** Put the three best combos of S1 on the menu of S2.
- **Expected impact:** Estimated 2,000 VND more per invoice at S2.
- **Effort:** Medium.
- **KPI:** avg_ticket (ALL)
- **How to read the KPI in the app:** Month report, store comparison card.
- **First step:** Choose the three combos this week.

### Initiative 3: Narrow ad-hoc discounts

- **Evidence:** The discount rate over the last four weeks is 4.25% [[kpi:ALL/discount_rate:w28]], above the 3.98% [[kpi:ALL/discount_rate:p28]] of the four weeks before.
- **Action:** Only a manager approves a discount outside a promotion.
- **Expected impact:** Estimated discount rate back to 3.8%.
- **Effort:** Low.
- **KPI:** discount_rate
- **How to read the KPI in the app:** Promotions and discounts, discount rate card.
- **First step:** Send the new rule to every shift.

### Initiative 4: Seasonal toppings

- **Evidence:** The topping attach rate fell 1.76 points [[kpi:ALL/attach_rate_topping:p28_change]] to 31.25% [[kpi:ALL/attach_rate_topping:w28]].
- **Action:** Add two seasonal toppings and show them at the counter.
- **Expected impact:** Estimated attach rate up to 34%.
- **Effort:** Medium.
- **KPI:** attach_rate_topping
- **How to read the KPI in the app:** Menu, attach rate card.
- **First step:** Try the two new toppings with the staff.

### Initiative 5: Morning traffic for S2

- **Evidence:** S2 has 10,400 invoices [[kpi:S2/invoices:w28]] in four weeks; revenue of both stores in month 2026-10 was 1.29 billion VND [[monthly:ALL/2026-10:net]].
- **Action:** Sell bread sticks with coffee from 6:30 to 9:00.
- **Expected impact:** Estimated 600 more invoices in four weeks.
- **Effort:** Medium.
- **KPI:** invoices (S2)
- **How to read the KPI in the app:** Day report, invoices card.
- **First step:** Order more bread sticks from next week.

## 4. 30/60/90-day plan

- 30 days: start initiatives 1 and 3.
- 60 days: start initiatives 2 and 4.
- 90 days: review and extend initiative 5.

## 5. Menu

Keep the class A items and review the class C items such as bread sticks.

## 6. Opening hours and staffing

Add one cashier between 17:00–19:00 at S1.

## 7. Promotion calendar

No new discount campaign before 15/12.

## 8. Risks

Regular customers may react when discounts are narrowed.

## 9. Data to collect

The seat count of S2 and the cost of the new items.

## 10. Assumptions

Traffic stays steady through the holiday season.
